notes: Summary: Large global 3PL with ~1.2k employees wants to move mission-critical routing assistant to dedicated inference.
Primary ask: guaranteed throughput for peak dispatch windows (regional peaks), strict p99 latency SLOs for chat-like interactions.
Customer quote on call 2026-02-20: 'We need predictable latency across regions — variability today breaks downstream SLA with carriers.'
Security: Must support SAML SSO and KMS-backed key management; prefer data residency options for EU and NA bases.
Cost sensitivity: willing to commit to reserved capacity (annual) if forecasts and SLA align — looking for clear RU/token economics for dedicated pools.
requirements_summary: Workload: routing-assistant + operator chat + document lookup (mixed chat + embeddings + reranking).
Target latency: interactive p50 < 40ms, p95 < 80ms, p99 < 180ms for 8k context usage patterns (short-turn dialogue typical).
Throughput: baseline 1.2k sustained requests/minute during peak, burst to 3k req/min for 5-10 minute windows; token throughput estimate ~12M tokens/day.
Availability: 99.95% target, cross-region fallback desired (NA primary, EU secondary).

Model preference: 70B-class dense + quantized variants for cost; open to Redwood-verified model family and tuned Llama-like variants; must support up to 32k context for long manifests but most traffic uses <8k.
Dedicated sizing ask: initial reserved plan guidance requested for 8x H100-equivalent GPUs with scale-out headroom; want a rack-level unit cost and burst pricing for additional capacity.
Quantization: evaluate q4_0 and q8_0 profiles for latency/quality tradeoffs; want blueprint for q3/q4 profiles for 70B to compare Delta-RLHF effects on throughput.
KV cache/batching: prefer persistent KV cache per session for routing context; target batch size tuning to preserve p99 SLO while achieving >70% GPU utilization.
